BiblicalUsage: Harmon is a name that appears once, in a verse about judgment on Samaria, and even the scholars are not sure whether it is a place or a palace. In Amos 4:3 the women of Samaria shall go out at the breaches and cast themselves into the palace, or into Harmon, and the uncertainty is part of the verse: the end of the proud is confusion.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the obscurity is honest to the text: Amos does not name a place I can find on a map, he names a fall, and the fall is the point.
